ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85% high-intensity (white) to 15% low-intensity (black) distribution; majority of visible surface is white with dark borders.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: A large contiguous high-intensity white region occupies the central lobes. Low-intensity black pixels are confined to a thin border along the trailing edge and broader patches at the distal tips. Two small, isolated dark focal spots are visible in the upper-central region of the lobes, positioned bilaterally.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 135 degrees and a bounding-box depth of approximately 15 pixels relative to the highest peak.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the superior boundary; peaks and valleys range from 1 to 4 pixels in depth, creating a jagged linear contour.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Overall convex curve along the trailing edge of both lobes, transitioning into a sharp downward convex sweep toward the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized dark pixel clusters are concentrated at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes; two distinct circular dark spots are located approx. 1/3 of the distance from the notch toward the tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular tissue boundaries and dark clusters at the distal tips suggest minor physical trauma or previous parasitic attachment sites.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly symmetrical placement of two dark spots in the upper-medial quadrants of the lobes.
